A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the plastic deformation behavior of the multilayered material with nanometer thickness is strongly dependent on the individual layer thickness, the number of interfaces in the composite, and the type of interfaces in the material.
the plastic deformation ability is determined by the individual layer thickness and the layer thickness ratio.
the plastic deformation behavior of the Cu/Ni/W multilayered material is similar to that of the Cu/Al multilayered materials.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the plastic deformation behavior of the composite with two kinds of interfaces is not necessarily better than that with only one kind of interface.
the plastic deformation behavior of the multilayered material is not only dependent on the layer thickness and interface strength but also on the individual properties of the constituent layers.
